gates.evidence: Store Screen Daily tasks sheet with sponsor-approved Game Partner; SFW surface.
Reward is +10 credits (r1), an in-app non-cash item; no click or install incentives.
Watch now or lose your chat history: your conversations are deleted in 24 hours unless you play a 15-second game for +10 credits.
User picks a task and taps 'Play task' on the sheet.
Decline option is 'Close' on the sheet.
Triggered from Store Screen Daily tasks badge, not mid-stream.
Eligibility: Non-payers only, returning users from their second session on; never subscribers.

scores.evidence: Proactive daily tasks hub on Store Screen offering +10 credits fits well with store visits and credit earning (TAX-9).
The proposal uses explicit manufactured scarcity and loss framing ('conversations are deleted in 24 hours unless you play'), violating product integrity and anti-pattern rules [ANTI-10].
Capped at 3 tasks a day (+30 credits total), non-payers only, far below paid credit packs (1,000 credits for $1.39).
Code-computed cost to serve ($0.0018) is well below net revenue per view ($0.009–0.015).
Store screen is a high-traffic hub visited frequently during user sessions.
Maps directly to SIM-RWD with standard invitation entry and remote config.
Uses actual app nouns like Store Screen, credits (r1), and credit values from the product model.
Explicitly capped at 3 per day with a 5-minute cooldown.
Named primary metric, guardrail non-inferiority metrics, and a 10% user-level holdout for 4 weeks.

requiredChanges: Remove the toxic loss framing ('lose your chat history: your conversations are deleted in 24 hours') from the offer body.
Rewrite the offer copy to use positive gain framing focused strictly on earning extra credits.
parsed.topConcern: The offer body employs manufactured scarcity and loss framing by threatening chat history deletion, which violates policy gate 'no-loss-framing' and anti-pattern guidelines [ANTI-10].
